# WealthMaster India

> AMFI-Registered Mutual Fund Distributor in Rajouri Garden, New Delhi. ARN 349461.

WealthMaster India is led by Amit Chadha (Founder & Mutual Fund Distributor) and provides mutual fund distribution, SIP assistance and investor education. It deals in Regular Plans and may receive commission from AMCs. WealthMaster India is not a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser.

- [Home](/): Build long-term wealth with confidence — overview of services.
- [About](/about): Mission, principles, and team behind WealthMaster India.
- [Explore Funds](/funds): Curated mutual funds across equity, debt, hybrid and ELSS categories.
- [SIP Calculator](/calculator): Estimate the future value of monthly SIP investments.
- [Get Started](/get-started): Request a consultation about mutual fund distribution support.
- [Book Consultation](/book-consultation): Schedule an investment consultation with Amit Chadha.
- [Contact](/contact): Call, email, WhatsApp or visit the New Delhi office.
